description: Invoice total is one cent below the sum of its line items.
howSeeded: Changed billing-service Money.of() to round each LineItem to 2dp before summation, instead of summing at full precision and rounding once.
decidingEvidence: The contract excerpt stating that rounding happens after summation, plus a test-history record showing the test was green on the previous build and has not been edited since.
twinAxis: Presence of an independent statement of what 'correct' means (contract excerpt + green history on an unedited test).
